kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Staffing (45% du CA). Intérim et placement permanent généraliste. Plus gros segment mais le plus cyclique (sensible PIB).
kpis.description_en: Staffing segment revenue (45% of sales). Generalist temp and permanent placement. Largest segment but most cyclical (GDP-sensitive).

kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Inhouse (25% du CA). Outsourcing complet d'une fonction client. 1931 implantations. Contrats long-terme, plus résilient.
kpis.description_en: Inhouse segment revenue (25% of sales). Full client function outsourcing. 1931 locations. Long-term contracts, more resilient.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Professionals (24% du CA). Placement de cadres et experts (IT, finance, ingénierie). Marges supérieures Staffing.
kpis.description_en: Professionals segment revenue (24% of sales). Executive and expert placement (IT, finance, engineering). Higher margins than Staffing.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Global Businesses (6% du CA). Randstad Sourceright, Randstad Enterprise, Randstad Digital (RPO, MSP, technology consulting).
kpis.description_en: Global Businesses segment revenue (6% of sales). Randstad Sourceright, Randstad Enterprise, Randstad Digital (RPO, MSP, technology consulting).

kpis.description_fr: Nombre total d'agences Randstad fin d'année. Réseau commercial mondial. Indicateur de présence physique vs digital shift.
kpis.description_en: Total Randstad branches year-end. Global commercial network. Physical presence indicator vs digital shift.

kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires consolidé Randstad. 5 ans d'historique. Plus grand staffing mondial (par CA). EBITA margin 4.2-4.7%.
kpis.description_en: Randstad consolidated revenue. 5-year history. World's largest staffing company (by sales). EBITA margin 4.2-4.7%.

notes: Source Annual Report 2023. Fiscal year = calendar year. Top mondial du staffing avec Adecco et ManpowerGroup. AEX index.
